title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
japaneseTitle: アンチャーテッド 海賊王と最後の秘宝
shortDescription: Nathan Drake's poignant final globetrotting treasure hunt chasing pirate Henry Avery's lost fortune across Madagascar and Libertalia.
historicalSignificance: The pinnacle of cinematic action-adventure storytelling on eighth-generation hardware, selling over 16 million copies and delivering benchmark character animation and vehicular chase physics.

editorialContent.overview: Retired from dangerous fortune hunting, Nathan Drake is pulled back into the underworld when his presumed-dead brother Sam resurfaces with a lethal debt. Together with Victor Sullivan and Elena Fisher, they track the legendary pirate haven of Libertalia.
editorialContent.gameplay: Seamlessly interweaves dynamic rope grappling, sliding slope combat, wide-linear vehicular exploration in Madagascar, and enhanced stealth cover mechanics.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Showcased unprecedented micro-facial fidelity, cloth wrinkling physics, real-time mud simulation, and seamless in-game cinematics rendered fully in real-time.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Provided a rare definitive, mature, and deeply satisfying conclusion to a flagship gaming protagonist's decade-long saga.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS4 optical media, re-released in the Legacy of Thieves Collection on PS5 and PC.

awards: BAFTA Games Award for Best Game 2017
